# 262: Thermal Gliders

## Overview

"Riding the heat of industry."

**Thermal Gliders** are specialized hauling drones that consume **0 Fuel**. Instead, they rely on **Updrafts** generated by hot machinery or vents. They can only move (or move efficiently) on tiles with High Temperature. In cold zones, they are grounded or crawl extremely slowly.

This creates a logistical puzzle: players must design "Heat Highways" using furnaces, pipes, or vents to connect their mines to their stockpiles if they want free transport.

## Dependencies

- `025` — Hauling Logistics (Drone base)
- `140` — Thermal Management (Heat map)
- `116` — Drone Networks (Drone entity)

## RED Phase: Tests First

Write these tests in `src/layer1/logistics/glider_tests.rs`. They will initially FAIL.

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use bevy_ecs::prelude::*;
    use crate::layer1::map::{GridPosition, TemperatureGrid};
    use crate::layer1::logistics::glider::{ThermalGlider, update_glider_movement_system};
    use crate::layer1::movement::MovementSpeed;

    #[test]
    fn test_glider_speed_boost_in_heat() {
        let mut world = World::new();
        let mut temp_grid = TemperatureGrid::new(10, 10);

        // Heat Highway at (0,0)
        temp_grid.set(0, 0, 50.0);
        // Cold Zone at (0,1)
        temp_grid.set(0, 1, 0.0);

        world.insert_resource(temp_grid);

        // Spawn Glider
        let glider = world.spawn((
            ThermalGlider,
            MovementSpeed(0.0), // Base speed 0? Or just modified.
            GridPosition { x: 0, y: 0 },
        )).id();

        // Run system
        let mut schedule = Schedule::default();
        schedule.add_systems(update_glider_movement_system);
        schedule.run(&mut world);

        let speed = world.get::<MovementSpeed>(glider).unwrap();
        assert!(speed.0 > 1.0, "Glider should fly in heat");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_glider_grounded_in_cold() {
        let mut world = World::new();
        let temp_grid = TemperatureGrid::new(10, 10); // Default 0
        world.insert_resource(temp_grid);

        let glider = world.spawn((
            ThermalGlider,
            MovementSpeed(1.0),
            GridPosition { x: 0, y: 0 },
        )).id();

        let mut schedule = Schedule::default();
        schedule.add_systems(update_glider_movement_system);
        schedule.run(&mut world);

        let speed = world.get::<MovementSpeed>(glider).unwrap();
        assert!(speed.0 < 0.2, "Glider should crawl/stop in cold");
    }
}
```

## GREEN Phase: Minimal Implementation

### 1. Components

```rust
// src/layer1/logistics/glider.rs

use bevy_ecs::prelude::*;
use crate::layer1::map::{GridPosition, TemperatureGrid};
use crate::layer1::movement::MovementSpeed;

#[derive(Component)]
pub struct ThermalGlider;

pub fn update_glider_movement_system(
    mut query: Query<(&ThermalGlider, &GridPosition, &mut MovementSpeed)>,
    temp_grid: Res<TemperatureGrid>,
) {
    for (_, pos, mut speed) in query.iter_mut() {
        let temp = temp_grid.get(pos.x as u32, pos.y as u32);

        if temp > 30.0 {
            // Updraft!
            speed.0 = 2.0;
        } else if temp > 10.0 {
            // Weak lift
            speed.0 = 1.0;
        } else {
            // Grounded
            speed.0 = 0.1;
        }
    }
}
```

## REFACTOR Phase: Quality & Design

- **Pathfinding**: Gliders need a custom pathfinding cost function that prefers Hot tiles. Standard A* will take the shortest geometric path (through cold) and get stuck.
- **Visuals**: Glider changes sprite (wings open vs closed) based on state.
- **Risk**: Too much heat (>100) damages the glider (melting).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `ThermalGlider` component exists.
- [ ] Movement speed scales with local temperature.
- [ ] Gliders are effectively immobile in cold (speed < 0.2).
- [ ] Tests pass.

## Technical Guidance

- Modify `pathfinding.rs` to accept a `CostFunction` trait or closure, allowing Gliders to inject `cost = 100 - temperature`.
